summary: Five-mod attack Emerald: fractured crit damage bonus, crit chance and a desecrated attack speed suffix via the over-cap Liquid Contempt route, plus an elemental or attack damage prefix.

steps: '20% crit damage' is read as attack crit damage bonus (the generic crit damage bonus rolls the same 10-20%; inferred from the attack build)
Buy rare 4-mod Emeralds with 20% attack crit damage bonus, ~1 div each (a pre-fractured one is ~9 div); planner base Emerald inferred from the attack mods
Fracturing Orb, 1 in 4 on a 4-mod jewel (expected 4 bases + 4 orbs per fracture; creator buys a new base per miss)
Annul twice down to the fractured mod, Chaos spam until attack crit chance (count not stated), Exalt twice to 4 mods
Potent Liquid Contempt for '+1 Suffix Modifier allowed' (50/50; '+1 prefix' breaks it, back to the annul step)
Preserved Cranium + Abyssal Echoes for a desecrated attack speed suffix; Omen of Light + Annul and retry on a miss
Omen of Sinistral Annulment + Annul removes the '+1 suffix' mod (50/50; he lost and finished with Sinistral Erasure + Chaos)
Exalt to 5 mods, Chaos until a good prefix (count not stated)
Not costed (no planner target): Potent Liquid Ferocity for the suffix-effect prefix (won on the third try), optional Divines and Reaver catalysts

factCheck.notes: Fractured crit damage family marked inferred (attack and generic crit damage both roll 10-20%); 4-mod base inferred from 'one and four' confirmed. Open: his 'roughly 1.5 divines to get your fractured jewel' contradicts 4 bases + 4 orbs. Upload 2026-06-13 (0.5 Runes of Aldur, after 0.5.2).
